title: Explain a caught value
prompt: Write `issueText(problem: unknown): string` for a value caught by `catch`. Return `problem.message` for an `Error`, the text itself for a thrown string, and `"Unknown"` for anything else. Keep empty strings.
hints: Check the kind first: `instanceof Error`, then `typeof problem === "string"`.
Use `"Unknown"` only after both checks fail.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses `String(problem)`, which gives `"Error: Denied"` instead of `"Denied"`.
Replaces an empty thrown string with `"Unknown"`.
